Code & scenery deep-dive

  • Files: js/circuits/interlagos.js (63 lines, def + OSM path), js/circuits/scenery/interlagos.js (1046 lines, lazy), brief docs/tracks/interlagos.md, landmarks tests/data/landmarks/interlagos.json (senna-s, main-tribuna, sp-skyline, guarapiranga, guarapiranga-shore).
  • Emitter counts (call sites in file): modelGroup 14 (+ bowl ring emitting up to 60 groups at runtime, :940-1046), forestEdge 5, every 2, grandstandEx 9, arquibancada helper 4, crowdBank 6, billboard 5, building 3, motorhome 1, cameraTower 1, marshalPost 8, fence 3, guardrail 3, wall 2, tyreWall 5, sponsorHoarding 2, place 7, backdrop 5, cityFront 2, groundPatch 1, broadcastCompound 1, gantry 1, hedge 2, tree 3, palm 4, bush 4. No peaks/mountains.
  • Lap-fraction anchors (racing space, no shift): pit tower/garages 0.95-0.05 (:314-351); Curva 1 stands/crowd 0.01-0.09 (:373-435); Senna S hero 0.055 side -1 18 m (:448); favela patches 0.11-0.315 side -1 at 68-90 m (:552-559) + hill backdrops every(120) 0.08-0.32 (:527); Reta Oposta stand 0.27 (:591); Guarapiranga lake anchored K(0.42) -1 at 520 m (:599-650, shore pier :668); Descida/Ferradura gravel+tyres+stand 0.435-0.4547 (:719-725); skyline cityFront 0.49-0.74 (:758,766) + hero cluster :763; Bico de Pato tyres 0.615-0.67 (:832); Junção stand 0.72 (:853); Subida/Arquibancadas stands 0.826-0.885 (:855-869); bowl ring around lap centroid (:940).
  • Camera-corridor logic: camHot windows 0.02-0.14, 0.36-0.50, 0.68-0.82, 0.86-0.02 (scenery:26-35) and dressingExclusions foliage (interlagos.js:20-32) strip generic trees where orbit/chase cameras sit - these windows are why most orbit frames show open ground with sparse palms.
  • Assets: no external model packs referenced; everything is addBox/addCyl modelGroup procedural geometry with baked PBR materials (MAT.CONCRETE/METAL/FABRIC/GLASS); prefetch lists 77 kenney_* models for the session generally.
  • Night lamps: none authored (lamp "none"); LIT_WIN colour boxes only. Bridges: none.
  • Preflight drops: verify-track warns 'suppressed backdrop=3 building=5 tree=59 palm=1' - authored props rejected by guards (count only; which ones not enumerated).
  • Real-world cross-check: length 4.309 km, 15 turns, counterclockwise, 'between two artificial lakes' (Wikipedia, URL above); favelas pressed to the perimeter per the brief's own research pass (not independently verified; not in the fetched Wikipedia text).

Ranked defects and suggested fixes (not applied)

#DefectFramesMechanism / file:line / suggested fix
1Wet/rain/storm terrain mirrors like waterFrames 19-23, 36-41, 48-53, 60-67Grass and dirt run-off render as a flat mirror: upside-down palm and building reflections, palm canopies blown white. Mechanism not in the circuit file; it is the shared wet-surface response (js/render/ + js/lighting/atmosphere.js, outside this read-only survey). Circuit contribution: palm()/tree() flat canopy discs (scenery:512-545, 696-713) are the high-specular shapes. Suggested: cap wet specular on terrain material (MAT 0) and check canopy albedo.
2Overcast and fog barely change the lookFrames 24-35Overcast day keeps a saturated blue sky; fog does not soften the skyline. def pal.fogDensity 0.0018 (js/circuits/interlagos.js:34) is very low against the brief's 'soft low fog, humid depth'. Suggested: raise fogDensity (~0.004-0.006) and tint horizon to the hazy blue-grey in docs/tracks/interlagos.md section 2; separately the overcast sky response is an engine matter.
3Night: city/favela unlit, no lampsFrames 54-67Skyline towers and favela cubes stay pale/flat at night. LIT_WIN (scenery:308) is a plain albedo colour at :580, :778, :815, and furniture lamp:'none' (interlagos.js:55) emits no lamp posts, so only the car light pool lights the road. Suggested: emissive/night-gated window material and a lighting kind along the straight (scenery-dress), or accept as day-only (def night:false).
4Skyline slabs read close to trackFrames 05, 11cityFront(0.52,0.69,+1, gap 180) and (0.49,0.74, gap 285) at scenery:758/766 put 40-104 m slabs within ~100-180 m of the road at eye level; brief says far horizon behind favela hills. Suggested: gap +120 m or lower maxH on the nearer row.
5Buried props (ground-audit 39)n/acrowdBank (js/track/scenery/nature.js:962) 12 prims worst 5.6 m deep; favela model groups scenery:82/86/93 up to 5.17 m; place() kerb strips scenery:492 7 prims 1.07 m buried (the comment at :486-491 says these were removed but the loop still emits them); :326 motorhomes 0.24 m. Suggested: remove the :492 loop; ground favela rows per-row; clamp crowdBank to terrainYAt.
6Turn table vs real numberingn/a (uncertain)def.turns (interlagos.js:54) has 15 entries with no Curva do Sol (0.117 appears only in bankZones :41); index 3 is 0.3137 = Descida do Lago, so turn labels may be off by one against the real T3 Curva do Sol / T4-5 Descida / T6-7 Ferradura (Wikipedia). Verify how HUD labels use turns before fixing.
7Favela/skyline look like cube stacksFrames 02, 03, 05Closed addBox cores with green plinths (scenery:49-120, 560-587, bowl ring 940-1046) read as terraced Lego rather than irregular brick terraces; documented design (DETAIL pass), cosmetic.
8Dusk golden bloom washFrame 46f67 dusk dry: left half washed with a golden haze. Likely bloom plus sun glare through dusk atmosphere; not circuit-specific.
9Stair-step aliasing on concreteFrames 01, 09Pit slab and stand facades show blocky stepped shading (shadow resolution). Engine-level.
10Dark monolith at Senna S exitFrame 07Tall dark-grey box on the left; I could not tie it to an emitter (candidates: backdrop HILL mounds :509-510, building at :317). Needs a world()/scene() probe.
11Grade exceeds brief claimn/aBrief says grade capped 5.5%; built 4 m-step grade reaches +7.35% (0.779-0.81 Subida), +6.7% near 0.44, -5.8% at 0.078. Real Subida ~10% (Wikipedia), so likely fine; brief text is stale.
12Coplanar fightsn/a3 same-facing coplanar spots, gap 5 mm, fight from 159 m (baseline 3, not a regression).
